name: menu
description: Three straight menu bars with rounded ends.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Menu frame extension: one shared three-bar glyph in None/Square/Circle, x=7..17 at y=8,12,16. Regular Outline is1.75 with radius.875 caps; standalone Filled is the exact Bold2.50 capsule expansion (radius1.25). Framed Filled subtracts that same standalone Bold silhouette from the solid frame, following the shared Filled-glyph frame convention. No per-frame glyph scaling or translation. Regular visible glyph bounds are x6.125..17.875/y7.125..16.875; Bold/Filled bounds x5.75..18.25/y6.75..17.25. Frame exterior bounds2..22: Square radius4, Circle radius10. Outline Square centerline bounds2.875..21.125/radius3.125; Circle radius9.125. Even at Bold, the circular frame retains positive glyph clearance. This frame-ready construction supersedes the earlier unframed 2px Menu fit; Search is unchanged. Native X/Y100/100, rotation0. Review reopened for the new shared glyph and frames.

review.note: Prior approval covered the larger unframed Menu. New frame-ready shared glyph and Square/Circle await owner review.

reviewHistory.note: Owner approved the current unboxed Filled = Bold 2.25 treatment and corresponding Regular 1.70 Outline. Shared centerlines and native proportions are retained, with 2px Filled primary margins.
